info.title: Admin API
info.description: Comprehensive administrative API for managing a multi-service communication platform. This API provides complete system administration capabilities including user management, subscription control, billing operations, and platform configuration. Features include role-based access control, package management for SMS/WhatsApp/USSD services, voucher system administration, API key management, and system maintenance operations. All endpoints require system-level authentication and are designed for platform administrators to manage the entire ecosystem of services, users, and business operations.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Manage user roles and permissions. Create, update, and delete role definitions with granular permission sets. Roles control access to different system features and API endpoints.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Manage user accounts and profiles. Create, update, and delete user accounts with customizable settings including credits, timezone, language preferences, and role assignments.

tags.name: Packages
tags.description: Manage subscription packages and service tiers. Configure package limits for SMS, WhatsApp, USSD, notifications, devices, API keys, webhooks, and other services. Control pricing and feature availability.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Manage user subscription assignments and durations. Create and manage active subscriptions linking users to packages with specific time periods and renewal cycles.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Manage billing transactions and payment records. Track payment history, refunds, and financial data across different payment providers and subscription types.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Manage system-wide settings and maintenance operations. Clear cache, manage system configurations, and perform administrative tasks that affect the entire platform.

tags.name: Languages
tags.description: Manage system languages and localization settings. Configure available languages, RTL support, language ordering, and internationalization preferences for the platform.

tags.name: Vouchers
tags.description: Manage promotional vouchers and discount codes. Create bulk vouchers, track redemption status, and manage voucher-based subscription activations for marketing campaigns.

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Manage API access keys for users and applications. Create, monitor, and revoke API keys with granular permission sets for programmatic access to platform services.

token.description: System token, can be acquired from system settings.

price.description: Price of the package, cannot be less than 1. This is based on system currency.

services.description: The list of services you want to allow for this package. Select from sms, whatsapp, android_ussd, android_notifications, api, webhooks, templates, actions, flows, ai separated by commas.

hidden.description: Hide the package from homepage and modal. 1 for yes and 2 for no.

footermark.description: Include the footer mark in sms/chats. 1 for yes and 2 for no.

receive_limit.description: SMS receive limit every cycle. Use 0 for unlimited.

scheduled_limit.description: Maximum number of scheduled sms/chats that can be created. Use 0 for unlimited.

wa_send_limit.description: WhatsApp send limit every cycle. Use 0 for unlimited.

wa_receive_limit.description: WhatsApp receive limit every cycle. Use 0 for unlimited.

wa_account_limit.description: Maximum number of WhatsApp accounts that can be linked. Use 0 for unlimited.
